verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (now Virtual Mail) serves agent-consumable markdown docs under reference.earthclassmail.com/_llms_txt/ for both the REST API and the MCP server. It also publishes a machine-readable MCP tool catalog and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 YAML, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, the evidence never shows a root llms.txt index file or describes these pages as an llms.txt entry point; their llms.txt orientation is inferred from URL paths. Missing for 10: a documented root /llms.txt (or llms-full.txt) index, explicit first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can consume them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: A machine-readable MCP tool catalog is served live at the API origin under /v2/.
The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
A full per-tool reference is published alongside.
